question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Cerulli projects households will transfer $123.7 trillion to heirs ($105 trillion) and charities ($18 trillion) between now and 2048.
items.quote: Cerulli projects households will transfer $123.7 trillion to heirs ($105 trillion) and charities ($18 trillion) between now and 2048.

items.text: Of the $123.7 trillion projected transfer, Generation Xers are expected to receive $39 trillion and Millennials $46 trillion.
items.quote: Generation Xers $39 trillion and Millennials $46 trillion

items.text: Of the $123.7 trillion projected transfer, Millennials are expected to receive $46 trillion.
items.quote: Millennials $46 trillion

items.text: Women in the Baby Boomer and older generations are expected to receive $40 trillion in 'horizontal' transfers as they outlive their husbands.
items.quote: women in the Baby Boomer and older generations are expected to receive $40 trillion in 'horizontal' transfers as they outlive their husbands.
items.scope: women in Baby Boomer and older generations

items.text: Women in younger generations are expected to receive $47 trillion of the wealth to be transferred intergenerationally.
items.quote: women in younger generations are expected to receive $47 trillion of the wealth to be transferred intergenerationally.

items.text: UBS estimates USD 83 trillion in private wealth will change hands globally over the next two to three decades.
items.quote: Over the next two to three decades, an estimated USD 83 trillion in private wealth will change hands globally

cells.reason: The passages state projected figures for the size of the generational wealth transfer from Cerulli and UBS.

cells.label: fact

items.text: Wealth is more likely to be held by older households, driven by rapid wealth creation and concentration.
items.quote: Wealth has been created and concentrated at a rapid pace in recent years and now is more likely to be held by older households.

items.text: The Great Wealth Transfer is driven by aging demographics, longer life expectancies and decades of rising asset prices.
items.quote: Driven by aging demographics, longer life expectancies and decades of rising asset prices

items.text: Next-generation inheritors are characterized by global mobility, rapid technological change, and evolving expectations around purpose and impact.
items.quote: Tomorrow's leaders and investors are coming of age in a world characterized by global mobility, rapid technological change, and evolving expectations around purpose and impact.

items.text: There are notable differences in service preferences among women and next-generation clients compared to current client demographics.
items.quote: notable differences in service preferences among women and next-generation clients compared to current client demographics

items.text: Women in younger generations are expected to receive $47 trillion of the intergenerational transfer; Baby Boomer and older women are expected to receive $40 trillion in horizontal transfers as they outlive husbands.
items.quote: women in the Baby Boomer and older generations are expected to receive $40 trillion in 'horizontal' transfers as they outlive their husbands. Meanwhile, women in younger generations are expected to receive $47 trillion of the wealth to be transferred intergenerationally.

cells.reason: The passages describe demographic trends and characteristics defining the transfer.

cells.label: fact

items.text: Researchers advise that advisors be thoroughly involved in clients' intergenerational planning and that home offices support advisors with expertise, investment products and technology to win future HNW business.
items.quote: Advisors should be fully aware of the risks future wealth transfers may pose to their practices and be thoroughly involved in their clients' intergenerational planning. Home offices must support their advisors by providing the expertise, investment products, and technology required to win the business of future HNW clients.

items.text: Research advises that advisors must see the client as the entire family and be equipped to serve the whole family.
items.quote: Advisors must see the client as the entire family… and we're equipping them to shift to that mindset and put in the practices to serve the whole family.

cells.reason: The passages state how firms and advisors should prepare to retain assets and relationships across generations, though without firm-specific net-new-asset figures.

cells.label: fact

items.text: Research notes aging demographics and an aging client base, but gives no advisor succession/headcount figures.
items.quote: Driven by aging demographics, longer life expectancies and decades of rising asset prices

cells.reason: Passages mention aging demographics but provide no advisor succession or headcount data.

items.text: Home offices must support advisors by providing the expertise, investment products, and technology required to win the business of future HNW clients.
items.quote: Home offices must support their advisors by providing the expertise, investment products, and technology required to win the business of future HNW clients.

items.text: Bank of America Private Bank offers trust and estate planning, business succession strategies, family education, and alternative investment strategies (private equity, real estate, opportunistic investments) to support wealth transfer.
items.quote: Bank of America Private Bank helps families plan for longevity and wealth transfer through trust and estate planning, business succession strategies, and family education... offers access to a broad range of alternative investment strategies, including private equity, real estate, and select opportunistic investments

cells.reason: The passages describe products, services and platforms offered to serve next-generation clients, though not specifically for the five named firms.

items.text: Bank of America Private Bank advisors facilitate conversations across generations to align financial plans with family values, helping clients preserve wealth, prepare heirs, and plan for extended lifespans.
items.quote: Advisors facilitate conversations across generations to align financial plans with family values, helping clients preserve wealth, prepare heirs, and plan for extended lifespans.

items.quote: Advisors must see the client as the entire family… and we're equipping them to shift to that mindset and put in the practices to serve the whole family.

items.text: Cerulli states that firms best prepared to meet recipients' needs are likely to shift marketshare.
items.quote: shift marketshare to those firms best prepared to meet these recipients' needs.
